meta_description:
486 likes, 8 comments - kubbrasait on October 29, 2026: "Art in the present can take its inspiration from art in the past. 🤍

At India Design ID, I met Nishita Kamdar @studionishitakamdar @pod_piecesofdesire whose beautiful swings bring a beloved piece of Indian home life into the present. She calls herself the OG swinger, and honestly, the energy is unmatched. Matteo and I had the best time chatting with her. At one point I wondered if the room was spinning. Nishita said maybe it was my head. 😅

Such a fun conversation about furniture, craft and the way design can transform a space.

@indiadesignid @matteocibic

[India Design ID, Pieces of Desire, Nishita Kamdar, Indian furniture design, handcrafted swings, Indian design, collectible design, interior design]".
